overview_description.description:
ClearCare is the industry leading home care technology platform and has raised over $75MM in venture capital to date including a $60MM round from Battery Ventures in August 2016. Our rapid growth in customers and revenue is driven by our innovative SaaS platform that helps manage all home care agency business functions, including scheduling, billing, payroll, senior-to-caregiver matching, CRM, HR, reporting, and point-of-care management. ClearCare' s web-based platform solves problems for all of the constituents involved in home care: family members, caregivers, seniors, agency staff and the healthcare community.

Healthcare is moving to the home with new technologies in remote monitoring, telemedicine, remote diagnostics, and medication compliance. In terms of cost, outcomes, and quality of life, no population stands to benefit from these developments more than seniors who are the largest consumers of healthcare. ClearCare, with its customers, is uniquely positioned to deliver transformative healthcare solutions that bend the cost curve for the world's most expensive patients.

Learn more about us here: www.clearcareonline.com
